race.description: The Mayor Of Airlie Beach Mdn Plate
race.comment: SOVEREIGN DASH (5) showed promise as a juvenile, and he has been to the fore at his first trial this season, scoring by a neck. The only query is the wide gate, but he has more upside than most in this, and is the one to beat for us. DREAM RIOT (4) was a sound runner-up on debut, and then was disappointing as the favourite here 5 days ago, finishing fifth. He has to be sharper for this quick backup, and the addition of winkers can make all the difference. Follow your money. ARIANNA'S GOLD (6) strips fitter second up, and all of her 6 career placings have been on this course. With luck from a wide gate, she can figure in the top 4 this time. ROLAND VIEW (9) is another maiden edging closer to her first win after running a bold second here nearly 6 weeks ago. Include. MYRTLE (12) has won her only public trial, and is in good hands for her debut. Follow the market moves.  SCARLET BULLET (13) showed enough in her first prep to suggest that she can pick up a win at short notice.
